title: Bar Juice 5000 Watermelon Strawberry Kiwi 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dive into a refreshing world of flavour with Watermelon Strawberry Kiwi by Bar Juice 5000. This e-liquid combines the sweetness of succulent watermelon and ripe strawberries with a hint of tangy kiwi, creating a perfectly balanced and irresistibly juicy vape experience. Crafted for fruit lovers, this blend is more than just a vape juice; it's a summer trio that offers a burst of freshness with every puff This premium e-liquid’s 40VG/60PG blend offers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. E-liquids formulated with nicotine salts are unique among vape products because unlike traditional freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than higher-strength freebase liquids. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Bar Juice flavours to make your mouth water. Bar Juice are a range of UK-made e-liquids inspired by the outrageously popular and utterly irresistible flavours found in disposable vape bars, such as those from Elf Bar and Elux. Unlike those disposable vapes, which send tons of useless plastic to landfill every year, Bar Juice e-liquids give you all the same great taste and satisfaction in a far more sustainable fashion. Made with a 20mg nicotine salt formulation for fast relief from nicotine cravings, Bar Juice 5000 e-liquids are ideal for starter kits and pod kits.
